title: SQM Q1 2026 Form 6-K earnings release
excerpt: Q1 2026 net income was USD 364.7 million or USD 1.28 per share; adjusted EBITDA was USD 837.0 million, while cash was USD 2.829 billion and total debt was USD 5.112 billion.
summary: The SEC-hosted issuer exhibit supports current lithium price and volume recovery, earnings, state payments, project gates, debt, cash, tax, minority-interest, and cyclical-normalization analysis for SQM.
